profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Tesla
profile.summary: Alejandro is a Software Engineer at Tesla working to build the tools needed to scale vehicle production globally. With experience across all facets of software development, he is able to build out established projects as well as architect solutions from scratch. Few things slow him down as he is able to find workarounds on the fly to maintain momentum. He works hard to lead projects and groups to meet goals, and is always looking to move forward, advance and make things better. Alejandro also pursues personal projects related to automation, optimization and self-hosted software solutions, which lend to his passion for innovation and problem solving.

positions.title: Family Room Specialist/Technical Expert
positions.description:
Respond to customer concerns appropriately and professionally, while upholding policy and procedure.
Communicate with peers and leaders effectively  to ensure daily operations run smoothly.
Extensive troubleshooting of Apple devices. 
Effectively identify unique customer and business needs.
Mentor and be mentored by team members to be able to make the team stronger.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description: I worked selling computers and computer merchandise at Fry's Electronics. On the sales floor, I worked to meet customers needs within their budget and keep the workflow productive and on track to meet the teams sales goals.

positions.title: IT Service Manager in Training
positions.description: Through my time in the service department, I worked helping customers troubleshoot their desktops, laptops,. As a supervisor, I was in charge of assigning tasks to a small team (5-7) of technicians to best suit their strengths and keep the team moving forward towards our weekly projections. Along with customer computers, I worked with a small team to maintain and fix computers in store to keep other store operations on track. Lastly, I worked to open and close the department in the store both with a team and alone.

volunteerExperiences.description: Looking after children, keeping them on schedule, getting them from one place to another etc.
